# Superheroes in film

Superhero films became a major part of cinema from the late 1970s. Superman (1978), starring Christopher Reeve, showed that a superhero film could be a serious blockbuster.

Tim Burton's Batman (1989) was another large hit. In the 2000s, X-Men (2000) and Spider-Man (2002) helped start a new wave of comic-book films.

The Marvel Cinematic Universe began with Iron Man in 2008. It linked many films into one shared story, an idea that led to The Avengers in 2012 and became one of the most successful film franchises in history.
